name: The Queen's Medical Center Teen Volunteers
what_you_do: Teens volunteer at the hospital. Roles include gift shop help, guiding visitors, delivering gift baskets and other help for patients. There is also a High School Summer Student Program.
who_can_apply: Teens 15 to 17 need parent permission and a shot record for MMR and varicella. All volunteers commit to at least 100 hours.
duration: At least 100 hours; summer student program also offered
deadline_text: Dates not stated on the page. Call Volunteer Services (Mon to Fri, 8 am to 4 pm) for the next start.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Teen Volunteers form (or the High School Summer Student Program form) linked on the Queen's volunteer page. Or call Volunteer Services (Monday to Friday, 8 am to 4 pm).
notes: The page lists Teen Volunteer forms for 3 sites. They are Queen's Medical Center, Queen's West O'ahu and Queen's North Hawai'i Community Hospital. The page does not say if applications are open now.
